# RewardsPro theme widgets

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../apps/rewardspro/extensions/theme-app-extension-rewardspro)

Embed loyalty and reward widgets into Shopify storefront themes using Liquid, JavaScript and CSS.

**Scope:** Theme extension with no package build step; enabling a block and backend availability remain host responsibilities.

**Placement:** Extension without a package.json.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. Assets, blocks, snippets and locale files are present. The shared RPUtils module owns common widget helpers.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Reuse RPUtils and verify widget behavior against current API and retirement boundaries; preserve translations and safe rendering.
